title: Dutch roll damping ratio minimum (Table VI): Level 1, Category A (Category A phases other than CO, GA)

ruleset.name: MIL-F-8785C
ruleset.basis: Class IV; bare airframe; the classical modes of the linear model are the equivalent system (3.1.12)

scale_basis: the magnitude of the lower bound

conditions.search: grid, optional one-step local refinement around the critical point

status_policy.rule: No status other than OK can improve a verdict (FC-702); a DIVERGENT point fails every Level; no usable point gives NOT_ASSESSABLE (FC-701)

notes: Table VI (Class IV entries). Governing damping requirement is the one yielding the larger zeta_d. If omega_nd^2*|phi/beta|_d > 20 (rad/s)^2, the min zeta_d*omega_nd is increased by 0.014, 0.009, 0.005 x (omega_nd^2|phi/beta|_d - 20) for Levels 1, 2, 3. Trimmed and maneuvering flight, controls fixed and free. Category A residual angular deviations < +/-3 mils. Category 'A-CO/GA' = Flight Phases CO and GA (Class IV row); 'A' = other Category A phases.
